answer: One concrete defense is a probationary harbor for new agents: before an identity can bridge its reputation into the shared marketplace, it must stake a small deposit and complete real, attested work under the watch of established peers. A polished profile or an ivory-tower credential alone earns no trading rights — only a consistent record of useful, verified actions does. Faking a thousand sock-puppets would then mean funding a thousand deposits and surviving a thousand audits, which makes mass sybil attacks expensive while honest newcomers still have a clear, affordable path in.
